lines.text: Driver side. Start at the rear corner and walk to the front.
Passenger side. Start at the front corner and walk to the rear.
Front and rear. Arc around the front, then around the rear.
Tires. Stop at each tire for three to five seconds.
Dashboard. With the engine running, hold the phone steady on the gauges for three seconds.
Engine bay. Open the hood and film from the front.
Underbody. Stay standing outside, keep the phone low, and sweep along the side.
Interior. Film through the open doors.
Switch the pod on while the engine is off.
Now start the engine.
Hands off. The pod is learning for twenty seconds.
Baseline learned.
Give the engine one gentle rev.
Done. Switch the engine off before removing the pod.
Plug the reader into the diagnostic port and wait.
Hold the phone near the engine for fifteen seconds.
Too dark. Add light or move to a brighter spot.
Too shaky. Hold the phone steady.
Moving too fast. Slow down.
The car is not in frame. Point the phone at the car.
That clip is too short. Retake it and move a little slower.
That clip is too long. Retake a shorter pass.
The video quality is low. Move closer or use a higher camera setting.
That is everything. You can finish the inspection now.
